title: Cucurbit[10]uril binding of heteroleptic iridium(III) complexes: synthesis and photophysical characterization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29414-29423
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03425F, Paper

Lubna Alrawashdeh, Shrouq Almarabeh, Khaleel I. Assaf, Anthony I. Day, Lynne Wallace, Suhair A. Bani-Atta
This study outlines a strategy to optimize the luminescence properties of heteroleptic iridium(III) complexes in an aqueous medium via encapsulation within a cucurbit[10]uril cavity with strong binding affinities.
